chunks: He narrated to me from one who asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man upon whom prayers had accumulated.
So he said: “Cast them aside and begin anew.”

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abā ʿAbdillāh, the kunyah of Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الرَّجُلِ: a man; the person being asked about in the ruling

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about someone upon whom prayers have accumulated?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a man upon whom prayers have accumulated. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام instructs that they be set aside and that he begin anew, indicating a jurisprudential directive related to salat.
